features.name: Normalized Volatility (ATR)

period.description: Period for Average True Range computation.

features.description: Average True Range divided by close price and scaled via tanh to represent volatility relative to price levels.

features.name: Normalized Rolling Volume

period.description: Period for the volume rolling average.

features.description: Asset volume normalized relative to its rolling average and scaled via robust tanh.

features.name: Price Momentum
features.description: Normalized percentage price return over period scaled via tanh.

features.name: Fair Value Gaps (FVG)

atr_period.description: ATR period for gap size scaling.

features.description: Bullish and Bearish Fair Value Gaps computed as displacement size relative to ATR, scaled via tanh.

features.name: Anchored VWAP Distance
features.description: Percentage distance of closing price from the Anchored VWAP (which resets at session boundaries), scaled via tanh.

features.name: Liquidity Sweeps

lookback.description: Lookback window in bars to define liquidity highs/lows.

features.description: Identifies sweeps of historical swing highs and lows that fail to close outside the range, scaled via tanh.

features.name: Order Block Proximity

period.description: Volume moving average period for OB classification.

features.description: Proximity of current price to active high-volume order blocks, with exponential decay over time.
